arms.label: Every segment continues the conversation's history (the default)
Every segment after the first starts with no history (--fresh)

caveats.message: A segment here is a follow-up turn of one attempt whose text restates the goal, not a wake-started goal segment: the server's goal block, checklist and owed-work pacing are not in the attempt. The arm changes exactly what --fresh changes, the history a turn starts with.

notes: Plan section 20, campaign 2 (work package 3): conversation context against --fresh on multi-segment tasks. Completion is verified success, cost is the attempt total, repeated work is the re-read count (a read of a target already read in the attempt). The question is superiority on verified success: is --fresh better than conversation context. The margin and the cost ceiling are the owner's to change. minTasks is 10: with the 3 to 5 tasks its tag selects today the verdict reads "No decision" with the reason "N tasks, 10 needed", which is the honest state until the task set grows.
